LanguageData.AcceptPatientsTooltip: Uncheck this if you want to stop patients from visiting.
LanguageData.AcceptSurgeryTooltip: Uncheck this if you do not want surgery patients.
LanguageData.AcceptDangerTooltip: Check this to override the check whether the map is safe for patients to arrive.
LanguageData.ShowMessageAtArrivalTooltip: Shows a message instead of a letter when a new patient arrives.
LanguageData.MassCasualtiesTooltip: A mass casualty event will sporadically overwhelm your hospital with patients.
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsHospitalDesc: Whether this bed is for patients.
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsSurgeryDesc: Whether this bed is for surgery patients.
LanguageData.RimWard.Offer.Label: Patient seeking treatment
LanguageData.RimWard.Offer.Text:
{0} ({1}) is asking to be treated.

Diagnosis: {2}
Estimated payment: {3} silver

Do you accept this patient?
LanguageData.RimWard.Alert.Explanation: Patients are waiting for your decision. Click their offer letter to accept or turn them away.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.Ambient: Treat injured allies on the map (contracts)
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.AmbientTip: When visitors/traders/allies get hurt on your map, you get an offer to treat them for pay.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.DifficultyDialTip: Scales disease and wound severity and overall case toughness.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.AutoRetryTip: A botched operation is re-attempted instead of leaving the patient uncured.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.NoFaultSurgeryTip: A patient dying on the operating table is clinical risk, not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.NoFaultLeaving: No penalty for deaths while leaving
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.NoFaultUnwinnable: No penalty if doomed on arrival
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.NoFaultProfitTip: "The operation was a success; the patient was not." Allows a net-positive outcome even on a no-fault death.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ChiefTip: Patients treated by a high-skill doctor pay more, like a private suite.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.RoyalRoom: Royal patients demand a quality room
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.IdeoGuilty: Ideology: guilt for turning patients away
LanguageData.RimWard.ThoughtTurnedAwayDesc: Someone came to us broken and pleading, and we shut the door. We are not who we claim to be.
LanguageData.RimWard.Bed.UseDesc: Who sleeps in this bed. With Hearth & Harbor this one button replaces the Hospital, Surgery and Guest bed toggles. Medical stays vanilla's own switch.
LanguageData.RimWard.Bed.GuestOff: Guest beds are not available (Hearth & Harbor inn module is off).
LanguageData.RimWard.Bed.GuestNotMedical: medical beds cannot be guest beds
LanguageData.RimWard.Bed.NeedsMedical: set the bed to Medical first
LanguageData.RimWard.Bed.NoPodSurgery: medical pods have no surgery use
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.HearthNote: Only does something when Hearth & Harbor is loaded.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.CombinedBedTip: Show a single "Use: Colonist / Guest / Patient" button instead of separate Hospital, Surgery and Guest bed toggles. Needs a Hearth & Harbor version with the selector protocol.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.LeisureTip: Patients who are up and about (not bleeding, no operation waiting) may visit Hearth & Harbor leisure places such as the spa while they wait to recover.
LanguageData.RimWard.Enum.IntakeMode.Hybrid: Hybrid: letter for surgery and nobles
LanguageData.RimWard.Enum.IntakeMode.Prompt: Prompt: a letter for every case
LanguageData.RimWard.Invoice.Factor.MedPref: Medicine as the faction likes it
LanguageData.RimWard.Invoice.Capped: Capped at the maximum payout of {0}
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.Discharge.Dismissed: {0} was sent home early and pays {1}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.Discharge.TreatmentImpossibl: {0} leaves untreated (treatment impossible) and pays {1}. No penalty.
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.Discharge.MaxStay: {0} reached the maximum stay, leaves and pays {1}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.Discharge.DiedNoFault: {0} died. Not your fault. The bill was {1}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.DiedFault: {0} died in your care. Goodwill {1} with {2}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Msg.LeftDespiteDanger: {0} waited long enough for the danger to pass ({1}) and leaves anyway.
LanguageData.RimWard.Offer.NoBed: No free patient bed. The offer stays open until it expires.
LanguageData.RimWard.Offer.UsesStock: Uses from your stock: {0} (worth {1}). The patient pays for it.
LanguageData.RimWard.Impossible.Label: Treatment impossible: {0}
LanguageData.RimWard.Impossible.Text:
{0} is waiting for "{1}", which cannot be done: {2}.
Discharge now: the patient pays the agreed share of the bill so far and leaves. No goodwill is lost. Keep waiting: the clock starts again.
Without an answer the patient is discharged in {3}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.Acute: Acute: downed, needs a bed and a doctor
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.NeedsTending: Wounds or illness still need tending
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.SurgeryRetry: Operation failed, a retry is scheduled
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.HeldByDanger: Cured, waiting for the danger to pass: {0}
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.Impossible.BillGone: the bill for {0} is gone and cannot be set up again
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.Impossible.NotPossible: {0} can no longer be done on this patient
LanguageData.RimWard.Why.Impossible.NoSurgeon: no colonist has the Medicine skill it needs
LanguageData.RimWard.Block.Closed: The hospital is closed (Hospital policies: Accept patients)
LanguageData.RimWard.Block.NoBeds: No patient beds (a medical bed set to Patient)
LanguageData.RimWard.Block.NoEntry: No reachable map edge for arrivals
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.Open: Hospital open, with at least one opening hour
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.Beds: At least one patient bed indoors
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.SurgeryBed: A surgery bed (surgery cases are accepted)
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.Doctor: A colonist who can walk and does Doctor work
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.Medicine: At least 5 medicine in stock (herbal counts)
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.Landing: A place for drop pods to land
LanguageData.RimWard.Ready.LandingNoSpot: no landing spot placed, pods land near the colony
LanguageData.RimWard.Policy.OwnMap: This map has its own policies
LanguageData.RimWard.Policy.OwnMapTip: Off: this map uses the policies of the whole save (all maps, and every new map after a gravship landing). On: changes here apply to this map only.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.OpenInNew: Open the hospital in new colonies
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.OpenInNewTip: A new colony starts with the hospital open. Nobody comes until there is a medical bed set to Patient. Existing saves keep what they had.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.SpecialNeedsTip: Off: patients who live on hemogen or need a deathrest casket are not sent. Their faction's own xenotype is always kept.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.MCEMasterTip: Master switch. Each save still has to switch them on in the Hospital policies.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ComplicationsTip: Extra ailments (a second illness, a chronic condition, a harmless addiction, a noble's room demand). Never one that kills or causes a berserk rage.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ChargeTip: Off: a charity ward. Nobody pays, goodwill still counts.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.EarlyPayTip: Share of the bill so far that a patient pays when sent home early, when treatment is impossible, or after a death that is not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.InvoiceLetterTip: Discharges that pay at least this much silver send a letter with the itemised invoice. Smaller ones send a message.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ReimburseMedTip: After a failed operation the patient's people pay for the medicine it used up. There is no fee for the operation itself.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ReimburseProsthTip: After a failed operation the patient's people pay for the parts it used up (prosthetics, organs).
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.MaxStayTip: After this many days a patient is discharged with the full bill so far. 0 = no limit.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.ImpossibleTip: A pending operation that cannot be done (part gone, nobody skilled enough, missing ingredient, refused) sends a letter after this time and discharges the patient after the same time again. No penalty.
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.DangerHold: Cured patients wait for danger at most
LanguageData.RimWard.Set.DangerHoldTip: Only active threats count (raiders, manhunters). Dormant mech clusters and weather never hold anyone.
